# Working in this project

Read the relevant requirements, source files, and local contribution instructions before changing the project.

Use a Task when work needs a durable record or a handoff. Keep its goal, current status, important decisions, next action, and completion condition accurate. Record useful checks and their actual results. Update existing information instead of appending repeated progress summaries.

A Task may reference another Task with `parent`. This is a relationship, not a separate role. Use as many Tasks as the work needs.

The forms are ordinary Markdown and work without repoctl. A Board is an optional overview. Follow the project's own instructions for building, testing, and delivering changes.
